paper_title: 3D template-based $Fermi$-LAT constraints on the diffuse supernova axion-like particle background
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, 95% CL observed upper limit (solid red line, benchmark DSNALPB scenario)
notes: Template-based analysis of 12 years of Fermi-LAT data constraining the diffuse supernova ALP background. Benchmark result: g_agamma < 3.76e-11 GeV^-1 at 95% CL for m_a << 1e-11 eV (mass-independent in this regime), encoded as a flat line up to the stated validity mass 1e-11 eV. Systematic variations shift the bound within [2.38, 7.04]e-11 GeV^-1. Not a DM search (relies on SN ALP production and Galactic B-field conversion), so no local DM density assumption.
